ConfineCursor.description: Keeps the cursor inside the game window while it is active.
plugin.name: Paradise Cracked Fusion Fix
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen shows the game on the whole monitor at the chosen resolution. Windowed opens a window with a picture of exactly that size. Borderless covers the monitor with a window. Restart the game to apply.
ResX.description: Mission resolution width in pixels; it replaces the resolution set in the game's options program. Zero uses the desktop resolution. Values below 800x600 use 800x600. Restart the game to apply.
ResY.description: Mission resolution height in pixels; it replaces the resolution set in the game's options program. Zero uses the desktop resolution. Values below 800x600 use 800x600. Restart the game to apply.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto keeps the mission interface at the screen edges. A ratio keeps it in a centred box of that shape. Applies immediately.
FMVWidescreenMode.description: Original shows the movies as the game does, inside the centred 4:3 menu picture. Fill shows the whole movie as large as the screen allows, without cutting anything off or stretching it. Applies immediately.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the mission camera's field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended view; larger values show more. Applies immediately.
SkipIntro.description: Starts at the main menu, past the publisher and studio logos and the title movie. The title movie stays in the Video menu. Restart the game to apply.
PauseOnFocusLoss.description: In a window mode, the game pauses while another window is active. Off keeps it running. Applies immediately.
CheckForUpdates.description: Once per start, asks fusionfix.io whether a newer version of the fix is out and tells you at the main menu. FusionFixHub opens the update page after the game exits, when installed beside the game. Off makes no network request.
update.availablehub: A new {name} version is available. Update it in FusionFixHub after closing the game.
update.availablesite: A new {name} version is available at fusionfix.io.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language used for the fix settings in compatible editors. Auto follows the editor language.
